hypothesis_title: Single macro KR Term Spread beta cross-section alpha
hypothesis_description:
WT_004 거시 잔차 composite REJECT_GRADUATION 인계.
발견: composite 정보계수 안정성 0.110 < 단일 KR Term Spread 0.187 = 합성 희석.
본 WT는 KR Term Spread 단독 beta로 cross-section alpha 정식 검증.
회전율 예상 150~250% (long-horizon, 한도 600% 정합).
직교성 target vs Hybrid 70/15/15 cor < 0.25.
Graduation: Harvey-t > 3.0 / DSR > 0.5 / ICIR > 0.20.
